image: Sociology Optional Strategy Session with AIR 10 Ujjwal Priyank
ForumIAS is organizing a special Sociology Optional Strategy Session with Ujjwal Priyank (AIR 10, UPSC CSE 2025) . The session will be organised in Online mode only.
Here is the e-Meet link: https://go.forumias.com/socio8june-8pm

Sociology is often considered one of the most scoring and manageable Optional subjects. However, success in Sociology requires much more than completing the syllabus—it demands conceptual clarity, effective answer writing, sociological thinking, and continuous revision.
In this session, Ujjwal Priyank will share his preparation journey and the practical strategies that helped him excel in the Civil Services Examination.
It is designed for aspirants who want to strengthen their Sociology preparation, improve answer quality, and understand the preparation strategy followed by a top-ranking candidate.
